export function outer(value: number): number {
  function inner(other: number): number {
    function innermost(last: number): number {
      return last + 1;
    }
    return innermost(other) + 1;
  }
  return inner(value);
}

export function sibling(value: number): number {
  const helper = (other: number): number => {
    return other + 1;
  };
  return helper(value);
}
